title: Prove a typed inverse-commutator exclusion for the PR5660 rewrite delta
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The exact four-delete/four-insert rewrite in [PR #5660](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5660) cannot create the specified typed inverse commutator. The predicate uses three distinct public roles, absolute anchor dimensions 1, 3, 5 and 7, a middle-role path from dimension zero to nine with increments `(1,2,2,2,2)`, and a strict scalar/owned observer corridor. Additional middle-role contacts at its unchanged endpoints are allowed.

The proof treats both ways a new incidence could arise: an inserted anchor, or removal of an old-only observer barrier. It quantifies typed programs satisfying the exact edit, frame and isolation premises. This rules out that source-delta lookup before a search is built. It does not establish a whole-word census, equality to the historical [PR #5650](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5650) payload, absence of other commutators, or a new scalar identity. There is no changed construction, invoice, kappa or selected frontier.

[Proof](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/77ee317339e4bf355d32207719a6d951c945d51c/research/p104-rewrite-delta-commutator-exclusion/PROOF.md) and [source manifest](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/77ee317339e4bf355d32207719a6d951c945d51c/research/p104-rewrite-delta-commutator-exclusion/SOURCES.json).

## Task and overlap

This is a focused finding from the donor-authorized conditional-kappa research effort. Scope key: `p104/pr5660/exact-four-edit/typed-commutator-delta-exclusion`.

The historical source is [PR #5660](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5660) head `3b0b4f37d5005f381ed9cfcccebfbe1ab35c71aa`. The submission starts from canonical main `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c` and adds only eight files in this new package. Four copied public text inputs retain their original bytes and source notices.

A fresh scoped check of [Discussion #5600](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19184345), [Discussion #5125](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5125#discussioncomment-19154639) and narrow changed-PR queries found no matching delta theorem. This is bounded overlap evidence, not exhaustive novelty. Corrected scalar reassociation is prior work. The earlier whole-word matcher domain remains unknown; this proof does not claim those screens missed a motif. The changed word in [PR #5678](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5678) is outside the theorem and receives no transferred exclusion.

## Validation

An independent local AI paper review checked the complete two-case argument, survivor provenance, partial-block cases, absolute dimensions and endpoint-contact clarification. It also checked why the final three old anchors being consecutive closes the X-only case without assuming X isolation. Final exact-byte review found no mathematical blocker.

All four retained text copies match their authenticated SHA256, Git blob hashes and byte lengths. All eight committed files at `77ee317339e4bf355d32207719a6d951c945d51c` were fetched back and match the reviewed local contents exactly. The GitHub comparison confirms one commit and exactly eight added files over the pinned canonical base. The package is self-contained for reading the conditional proof and its source declarations.

This is an unregistered static proof package; the optional generic replay hook is not claimed. No constructor, retained module, WORD decoding, motif census, numerical experiment, endpoint/native replay or actual old-word comparison was run. No executable checker, synthetic RESULT or replay receipt is supplied. Typed validity and the exact edit/isolation/frame premises are hypotheses of the theorem. Independently instantiating those hypotheses on actual released words is a separate obligation. [Hosted run 40274089879](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40274089879) failed in the unchanged shared Onboarding helper tests: current-CI documentation lacks the selected [PR #5599](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5599) review and source-manifest links. The replay job was skipped. The exact plan log was inspected; these paths are outside this eight-file addition. No hosted pass or scientific replay is claimed.

## Credit

Credit Ali Romman for [PR #5660](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5660), [PR #5644](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5644) and [PR #5627](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5627); zxv for [PR #5643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5643) and [PR #5650](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5650); the A2 lineage in [PR #3998](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3998)/[PR #4019](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4019); [PR #5651](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5651) for its retained comparison; and the cumulative P104, native, helper, caller, controller and compiler contributors. Related scalar-reassociation work in [Discussion #5600](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5600#discussioncomment-19184345) is credited. The general commutator identity is not new. Original text inputs and notices are retained under Apache-2.0.

Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate local paper review. This is not independent human acceptance or a proof-kernel verification of integer multiplication.

## Open next questions

The README separates actual-word typing instantiation, the missing historical matcher-domain specification, and a fresh assessment of later source edits. No occurrence lookup is useful for the exact delta class proved empty. The later [PR #5678](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5678) paid-basis construction needs its own source-bound reasoning; this theorem does not constrain it.
